variants.headline: A new government takes shape
variants.body: A new government has been formed in {colony}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Formation is the beginning of governing
variants.body: The colony has a newly formed government. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: New ministry, practical obligations
variants.body: Government formation has produced a new administration in {colony}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
